He wrote nothing back, but when the beam turned toward the horizon, he paused for a second, as if the sea could carry his silence to whoever had waited for an answer.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市还浸在深蓝色的梦里。街灯把潮湿的路面照成一条安静的河，偶尔有出租车驶过，灯光一晃即逝。写字楼只剩几扇窗亮着，便利店的白光温暖而孤单。环卫工人的扫帚划过街道，发出细碎的沙沙声。早餐铺开始冒起白汽，香气穿过冷雾，提醒人们天快亮了。此刻没有喧哗，只有城市卸下防备后的呼吸，缓慢而温柔。","w03":"- Recursion means solving a problem by using a smaller version of the same problem.\n- You keep repeating that step until you reach a simple case with an obvious answer.\n- Then each smaller answer gets passed back up until the original problem is solved."}
